description: Adversaries may enumerate files and directories or may search in specific locations of a host or network share for certain information within a file system.
artifacts: SMB directory listing requests within connected shares
SMB Read/Query Directory requests on share paths
directory traversal patterns within mounted shares
UNC path directory listing commands (dir, ls)
sequential file and directory enumeration within shares

pcaps.name: Internal domain admin SMB UNC browse admin shares (cmd dir)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated domain admin SMB UNC path browsing of administrative shares using cmd dir command.

pcaps.name: Internal domain admin SMB UNC browse admin shares (impacket-smbclient ls)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated domain admin SMB UNC path browsing of administrative shares using impacket-smbclient ls command showing successful directory listing.
pcaps.command:
printf "use C$
ls
use ADMIN$
ls
exit
" | smbclient.py 'AD/Administrator'@10.10.10.30 -port 445
